topic: Dependency-and-utilization audit of @spec-kit/shared after the memory-database retirement: every module judged by what actually imports and calls it, never by its stated or README-claimed purpose. Consumers: system-spec-kit/runtime, system-skill-advisor, system-deep-loop, sk-doc, .opencode/bin.
